text:
Ana: Heads-up — legal + security + product sync needed on long-term audit storage tradeoffs. Customer asking for customer-managed keys + 7y retention; we need to surface costs, ops impact, and launch gates.

Matt: Agree. We should separate compliance evidence (SOC2/ISO) from raw audit telemetry used for diagnostics. Different retention SLOs and access controls.

Sophie: From infra POV long tail storage at 7y is non-trivial — cold blob + index for search. Can we propose tiered retention (30d hot, 1y warm, 7y cold) and cheaper query patterns?

Kevin: Legal: some enterprise contracts expect immutable copies and chain-of-custody. We'll need exportable evidence packages for legal hold. That affects format & metadata.

Ana: Proposed launch criteria draft: 1) customer-managed keys support for exported evidence, 2) retention tiering implemented, 3) searchable metadata for investigations, 4) SLA for evidence exports (48h). Thoughts?

Matt: Add: audit integrity proofs (signed manifests) for exported packages. Also KMS attestation logs for key access during export.

Sophie: Ops questions: who owns lifecycle transitions? automation or manual? If automation, we need runbooks for unintentional deletion and recovery windows.

Kevin: Legal hold override: ability to pin tenant data beyond retention during active litigation. Need API + UI controls and audit trail for overrides.

Ana: Cost estimates — Sophie can you give rough monthly $/tenant for 7y at cold tier vs 1y? We'll use that for pricing/committing to customers.

Sophie: Will do, but initial back-of-envelope: cold object store ~ $0.0008/GB/mo, indexing/search adds marginals. I'll surface a matrix.

Matt: Security note: customer-managed keys for in-flight operations add complexity. Recommend MVP supports CMK for exported archives only, not for every active disk — lower ops risk.

Ana: That sounds like a reasonable compromise. We'll capture as "Export CMK MVP" and schedule full CMK-in-place as a follow-up.

ops-bot: New issue created: RT#4321 - audit-storage-tiering + export-cmk-mvp (assigned: Sophie).

Kevin: For SOC2/ISO evidence, define a canonical export schema now so we don't rework later. Minimal fields: event_ts, actor_id, action, resource, outcome, signature.

Sophie: I'll prototype schema + cost matrix and post in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

Ana: Great. After Sophie posts, Kevin and Matt please review for legal & security edge cases. We'll aim to have launch criteria locked next Wed. :calendar:

Matt: ACK.

Kevin: ACK.

Sophie: ACK — will post deliverables.
